subject.title: RFC 0024: Localization Runtime and Product Coverage

question: Should OpenClaw now sponsor a coordinated localization runtime and completeness program despite the April 5, 2026 decision to defer broad localization work?
rationale: The proposal is technically detailed, but its five implementation streams commit several owner groups and reverse a recent explicit product-direction decision; repository evidence cannot establish that sponsorship automatically.

options.title: Defer pending sponsorship
options.body: Keep the RFC draft unmerged until named Gateway, channel, catalog, plugin, and release owners confirm scope and implementation bandwidth.

options.title: Sponsor the full RFC
options.body: Approve the 22-locale shared contract and five-stage rollout after recording each owner decision in the required discussion thread.

options.title: Narrow the first RFC
options.body: Limit this RFC to locale resolution and safety/runtime message descriptors, leaving metadata and release completeness to later proposals.

recommendation.title: Defer pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the RFC draft unmerged until named Gateway, channel, catalog, plugin, and release owners confirm scope and implementation bandwidth.

likelyOwner.reason: This person made the clearest prior project-level decision on the same localization initiative.
